title: Server component rendered twice with getStaticParams

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Issue was opened via the bug report template.

body:
### Verify canary release - [X] I verified that the issue exists in the latest Next.js canary release ### Provide environment information Operating System: Platform: darwin Arch: arm64 Version: Darwin Kernel Version 20.4.0: Thu Apr 22 21:46:41 PDT 2021; root:xnu-7195.101.2~1/RELEASE_ARM64_T8101 Binaries: Node: 16.16.0 npm: 8.11.0 Yarn: 1.22.17 pnpm: N/A Relevant packages: next: 13.0.2 eslint-config-next: 13.0.2 react: 18.2.0 react-dom: 18.2.0 ### What browser are you using? (if relevant) _No response_ ### How are you deploying your application? (if relevant) _No response_ ### Describe the Bug The Server Component renders twice in production environment when defining `generateStaticParams`, it is also called twice in the build process. This is basically the code I used to showcase the behaviour: ```javascript export async function generateStaticParams() { return [{ id: "1" }, { id: "2" }] } export const revalidate = 5 async function Day({ params }) { const { id } = params console.log("id: ", id) return (

Component

); } export default Day ``` Another thing to notice is that each time the component seems to receive different `params` for the same `id` ### Expected Behavior Server Component rendering only once ### Link to reproduction - Issues with a link to complete (but minimal) reproduction code will be addressed faster https://github.com/lsvargas/nextjs13-bug ### To Reproduce 1) Clone the [repo](https://github.com/lsvargas/nextjs13-bug) 2) Run `yarn build && yarn start` 2) Click the button to navigate to the url and see the console
